title: Total weight of supersets
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $b4$ be a real number, and let $S$ be a subset of $bbrange{n}=bbrange{n}$ (the indices $0,bbrdots,n-1$). For each subset $J$ of these indices, assign weight $b4^{|J|}(1-b4)^{n-|J|}$. The sum of the weights over all $J$ containing $S$ is $b4^{|S|}$.
hypotheses_covered: $b4$ is real, with no further restriction
$S$ is a subset of the indices $0,1,\ldots,n-1$
